name: Misleading Love
overview: Scripture warns against a love that misleads by harboring grudges or seeking personal vengeance, emphasizing instead the command to love one’s neighbor as oneself (Leviticus 19:18). True love promotes forgiveness and unity, as covering transgressions fosters love while repeating offenses divides friends (Proverbs 17:9). Believers are called to relinquish revenge, trusting God’s righteous judgment rather than taking wrath into their own hands (Romans 12:19). Additionally, the faith community is to receive those weak in faith without engaging in divisive disputes, reflecting a love that builds up rather than fractures (Romans 14:1). This contrasts with the deceptive allure of worldly power and temptation, reminding believers to remain steadfast in genuine, patient love amid trials (Luke 4:5; Romans 5:3).
